##### Project general facts

Equiti Arcade is a stunning residential development that epitomizes the perfect blend of modern living and serene community. The project's sleek lines, modern forms, and carefully composed façade create a truly elegant and innovative exterior that sets the tone for a sophisticated living experience. Residences boast spacious layouts and large windows, flooding the interiors with natural light and creating a sense of brightness and airiness that is simply captivating. The project features a range of residence formats, from cozy one-bedroom apartments to spacious three-bedroom units, all carefully crafted to provide the ultimate living experience.

The project boasts an impressive array of amenities, meticulously curated to promote relaxation and well-being. A stylish swimming pool, dedicated wellness center, and state-of-the-art gym are just a few of the many highlights, providing residents with the perfect spaces to unwind and rejuvenate. The project also features beautifully appointed retail units, adding to the convenience and allure of this exceptional development. These beautifully integrated amenities come together to create a lifestyle that is perfectly balanced, where comfort, leisure, and modern living blend seamlessly.

Interiors are finished with the finest materials, emphasizing clean design, open layouts, and a light, airy atmosphere that enhances everyday living. Equipped kitchens offer utmost practicality, while premium finishes elevate the sense of comfort and refinement. The modern finishing with high-quality materials ensures that every aspect of the project exudes luxury and sophistication, making it a true masterpiece of design and craftsmanship.

##### Location description and benefits 

This prestigious development is situated in Al Furjan, a progressive and sought-after locality in Dubai that offers the perfect balance of affordability, serenity, and convenience. The area is the choice of those seeking a serene and convenient lifestyle, with everything needed within the vicinity including shopping malls, transportation facilities, and Dubai attractions. Located next to Discovery Gardens, Al Furjan is a family-oriented community with a well-connected location that ensures residents enjoy both tranquility and accessibility.

The neighborhood is one of the best areas for non-drivers in Dubai, with various metro stations located nearby providing seamless connectivity to the rest of the city. The area's progressive character and excellent infrastructure make it an ideal choice for those seeking modern urban living with the convenience of public transport. The well-planned community ensures that residents can enjoy a high quality of life with all essential services close at hand.

The location offers convenient access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Ibn Battuta Mall, Expo 2020, and Al Maktoum International Airport, all within a short drive. The area's strategic positioning ensures that residents are well-connected to key destinations throughout Dubai while enjoying a peaceful residential environment. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of suburban tranquility, transport connectivity, and urban convenience, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most desirable residential communities.
